# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SQUEEZE_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon contracts indicating low volatility, a breakout with above-average volume captures the subsequent expansion move. This setup aims to capture the volatility expansion phase that follows a period of compression, leveraging the EMA ribbon as a dynamic volatility filter and volume confirmation to avoid false breakouts.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When the 5-EMA, 8-EMA, and 13-EMA ribbon width (max-min) is less than 0.1 * ATR(14) for three consecutive 5-minute bars, and the close of the third bar is above the high of that bar, and volume of that bar is greater than 1.5 * average volume of the past 20 bars, then enter long at the open of the next bar.
Exit shape: Initial stop at the low of the squeeze candle (third bar); target at 2R; if price reaches 1.5R, trail stop using chandelier exit (3 * ATR(22)).
Regime hint: Best in low VIX (<15) and during regular trading hours (09:45-11:30) when compression often precedes news-driven moves; avoid during high VIX (>25) or first/last 15 minutes.
